propositions: git status --porcelain and git rev-parse HEAD probes in repo-isolation hooks ran without subprocess timeout, allowing hung Git children to block pytest after test completion
subprocess.run calls within autouse teardown were vulnerable to test monkeypatches of the shared subprocess module, causing the guard to invoke test doubles before teardown restoration
the five-second fixed watchdog must be applied to both porcelain() and head() probes and explicitly re-raise TimeoutExpired rather than collapse it to None

subprocess internals called time.sleep during Popen._wait backoff under load, making them vulnerable to test-patched time primitives; stable sleep must be provided only to subprocess during bounded probe execution
the bound _run_process callable and stable sleep namespace prevent test doubles from contaminating the repo-isolation guard while preserving all probe timeouts and exception semantics
